As a first test of [[Mesmer]] abilities, try out the ability of [[hex]] removal by helping a cursed priest.

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = factions
| profession = Mesmer
| primary = y
| secondary = n
}}

===Objectives===
* Travel to the [[Shrine of Maat]].
* Cure [[Brother Sitai]] of his affliction and restore order at the Shrine of Maat.
* See [[Mei Ling]] for your reward.

===Early benefits===
* You receive the following skills after accepting this quest:
** {{skill icon|Backfire}}
** {{skill icon|Shatter Hex}}

===Reward===
* 1,000 [[Experience]]
* 50 [[Gold]]

==Walkthrough==
Follow the quest arrow to the Shrine of Maat and kill any enemies that attack your party on the way. You'll know you're at the Shrine if you see a couple of [[NPCs]] outside of the temple talking about Brother Sitai. Brother Sitai is located in the Shrine of Maat itself, and you'll notice he has a hex on him. Simply target Brother Sitai and use a hex removal skill on him, and the quest will be completed.

==NPCs==

===Allies===
*{{x}} 10 (20) Brother Sitai
*{{x}} 10 (20) [[Faozun]]
*{{x}} 10 (20) [[Guardsman Po]]
*{{x}} 10 (20) [[Je Ling]]

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;'''Mei Ling'''
:''"What a fortunate time to begin your training. The priest who tends the Shrine of Maat in [[Sunqua Vale]] seems to have been Hexed with an unusually powerful experimental [[Illusion]] and has become a danger to himself and those around him. Please travel to the Shrine of Maat and cure Brother Sitai of his unfortunate problem. You will need to bring along a Hex-removal skill in order to complete this lesson."''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = It is an honor to serve.
| decline = I must prepare first.
| ask = I think [[Headmaster Kaa]] would be pleased if his...that is, this experimental Illusion was disposed of. See to Brother Sitai at the Shrine of Maat, if you would.
}}

===Intermediate dialogue===
;After hex removal
:'''Brother Sitai:''' ''"You have my eternal gratitude, friend. I was not my self."''
:'''Faozun:''' ''"Thank you so much. Now my journey will not have been in vain."''
:'''Je Ling:''' ''"Oh, thank you for restoring that poor priest to his rightful self! I must make my offering now."''
:'''Guardsman Po:''' ''"Very impressive. I thank you for handling that. I wish I had been able to myself."''
:'''Brother Sitai:''' ''"I must remove yesterday's offerings so our visitors can leave more offerings today."''
:'''Faozun:''' ''"I come here every year to make my offering to Maat."''
:'''Je Ling:''' ''"My brother has gone on a journey over the mountains, and I appeal to Maat to keep him safe."''
:'''Guardsman Po:''' ''"All spirits of Nature {{sic}} must be appeased."''
:'''Brother Sitai:''' ''"I must keep the shrine in pristine condition at all times. Scattered offerings anger the spirit."''

===Reward dialogue===
;Mei Ling
:''"I appreciate your efforts and your discretion. Headmaster Kaa is a great man, but sometimes his enthusiasm and thirst for knowledge get ahead of his... Ah, nevermind. You have done well."''

==Notes==
*Keep in mind that any member of your party can remove the hex and the quest will be successful, and also that [[Taya]] carries the skill [[Remove Hex]] and will use it to complete the quest for you.
*It is not known exactly what [[hex]] Brother Sitai was hexed with.

{{bug|Sometimes Brother Sitai will not be hexed from the start, and you will have to [[re-zone]] and do it again.}}

{{bug|[[Holy Veil]] can not be used to remove the hex for some reason, you will have to re-zone and bring a different hex removal}}
